text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our first three years
with Biwa Hayahide came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those truly precious "first three years."
And now, having finished that "Arima Kinen," she—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun. Let's identify the current issues.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "First, I want to gain more experience. The Senior-class Umamusume showed brilliant quick-thinking during the race. I also need to account for the impact of intuition born from real experience..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Trainer-kun?
Were you listening to what I just said?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Three years may be over,
but our races still continue, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—What good is a 'Winning Formula' if you don't always win?
Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her arms crossed calmly, she gazed back at me.
Her presence was undeniably that of a 'champion.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: Let's keep winning from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh... Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And while discussing future training plans
with Biwa Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I came to say one thing.
Next time, I will be the one overtaking you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What if I told you I won't let you pass so easily?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Even so, I'm gonna overtake you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
That's so like you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Big sis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: See you at the races.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…………Yeah. Let's run again.
Together, in a race……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an awkward conversation for sisters.
Yet the smiles crinkling on their faces
looked identical on both of them.
